lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Two hundred and ninety megawatts rated. Be advised the decay rate here is measured at seventeen a wave, not nine.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Then there is no build that holds this anchor. I want that on the record before you ask me for one.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: I'm not asking for one. I'm asking what fails first.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: That's a much better question and I have an answer for it. Restorers first, guns second, and put nothing on the far lane you aren't prepared to switch off.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Ceiling's at one ninety-six. You built for two thirty.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: One twenty-eight. That's the floor — it stops here. Small mercy, and I mean small.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over. Everything you have is firing at two thirds and the ceiling is still coming down.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Shed the outer lane. All of it. Ring only.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Held. We finished on four emplacements out of twelve and I could not tell you which four I'd pick again.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: The ones that were still on.
